preamble: The voiced velar plosive /g/ becomes the voiced alveolar sibilant [z] through palatalization and assibilation, usually via an affricate stage [dz]. In Slavic the second regressive palatalization turned *g before front vowels into *dz, which simplified to z everywhere except Polish and early Old Church Slavonic.

examples.note: Second palatalization *g > *dz before the front vowel; Old Church Slavonic still writes кънѧѕь with the dz letter, while Russian and Czech kněz have z and Polish ksiądz keeps dz.
Satem reflex of the palatovelar; compare Sanskrit jñā- and Avestan zainti- 'understanding'.
